title: AuricPass - Battle Pass Seasons
description: Fully customizable and 100% professional battle pass plugin! seasons, levels, bonus reward levels, PAPI compatibility, and more.
body:
# 🌟 AuricPass - The Ultimate Battle Pass Experience
**AuricPass** is a lightweight, highly customizable, and independent Battle Pass plugin for your Minecraft server. Reward your players with an engaging progression system, featuring both Free and Premium tracks, custom GUI designs, and a unique Prestige system!

## ✨ Key Features
* **Free & Premium Tracks:** Offer a standard reward line for everyone and an exclusive premium line to monetize your server.
* **Prestige System (Extra Rewards):** The grind never stops! Players who reach the max level enter an infinite loop, earning "Extra Rewards" for every specific amount of XP they gather.
* **Smart 6-Row GUI:** Fully customizable menus with intelligent math-based pagination. Design your layout exactly how you want it.
* **Standalone XP Economy:** AuricPass uses its own XP system via commands (`/auricpass xp give`). This means you can integrate it with ANY other plugin (Quests, MythicMobs, Crates) just by running a console command!
* **Season System:** End the current season with a single command, automatically saving a backup. Restore any previous season instantly if needed. Fully configurable history limit.
* **Advanced Command Execution:** Rewards can trigger multiple actions. Use tags like `[console]`, `[player]`, `[message]`, or `[close]` to execute exactly what you need.
* **Hex Colors & MiniMessage:** Create stunning visuals with RGB gradients and modern formatting.
* **Real PlaceholderAPI Integration:** All `%auricpass_*%` placeholders work natively in any PAPI-compatible plugin. Supports per-player lookups like `%auricpass_level_Steve%`. PlaceholderAPI is completely **optional** — AuricPass has its own internal placeholder engine!
* **Seasons:** It features a season system that you can end via commands, save, and restore at any time.

## ⚙️ Commands
* `/auricpass open [player]` - Opens the GUI. *(auricpass.commands.open)*
* `/auricpass xp give/remove/reset/check <player> <amount>` - Manage XP. *(auricpass.commands.xp)*
* `/auricpass premium give/remove <player>` - Gives or removes the premium pass. *(auricpass.commands.premium)*
* `/auricpass season end/restore/list [name]` - Manage seasons. *(auricpass.commands.season)*
* `/auricpass reload` - Reloads config, languages and player data. *(auricpass.commands.reload)*

## 👑 Permissions
You can also grant the premium pass with the permission `auricpass.premium`. The `auricpass.admin` node grants all sub-permissions at once.
* `auricpass.premium` - Grants the player access to the Premium reward track
* `auricpass.commands.open` - Access to the command that opens the selected player's pass
* `auricpass.commands.premium` - Access to the command to give or remove the premium pass
* `auricpass.commands.reload` - Access to the command that reloads the settings and player data
* `auricpass.commands.xp` - Access to the XP command with all its variants
* `auricpass.commands.season` - Access to the season management commands

## 🔗 Placeholders
Requires PlaceholderAPI for use in external plugins. The internal engine works everywhere inside AuricPass without it.
* `%auricpass_level%` - Displays the player's current level
* `%auricpass_xp%` - Shows the XP the player has earned at their current level
* `%auricpass_required%` - Shows the total XP required to advance to the next level
* `%auricpass_xp_left%` - Shows the XP still needed for the next level
* `%auricpass_premium_status%` - Displays the player's status (Premium or Free)
* `%auricpass_premium%` - Returns `true` or `false` based on the player's premium status

All placeholders also support per-player lookups by appending the player name: `%auricpass_level_Steve%`, `%auricpass_xp_Alex%`, etc.
